candidate.sourceFingerprintMethod: scripts/verification/begin-verification-run.mjs candidate-bound run context; clean working tree relative to HEAD when test commands ran. The launch packet was authored after the runs and is an audit deliverable, not executable source.

sourceEvidence.disposition: Defines audit_events actor, subject, action, transition, old/new state, reason, request and signature fields, plus the outbox dedupe key.
Adds audit/outbox indexes only; comments explicitly defer idempotent_commands pending an approved command strategy. This migration alone does not establish audit immutability.
Adds BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE append-only triggers for audit_events and controlled evidence tables.
Adds TRUNCATE guards for audit and controlled history, extending the row-level append-only controls.

Document identity/version create, draft CAS, review/transition and two-version supersession execute in database transactions with paired audit/outbox calls when production action dependencies are supplied.
Receiving create, draft update, correction and state transition are transactional and append audit/outbox through transaction-bound repositories when injected.

Inspection creation, equipment/AQL/form/result writes and state transitions use transactions; result and lifecycle evidence is appended in the same transaction. Production mutation factory passes audit/outbox; inspection creation also binds the receiving-origin audit/outbox event.
Template create, lifecycle transition and revision creation are transactional with audit/outbox calls.
Laboratory create/save and run-equipment evidence are transaction-scoped; lifecycle snapshots, audit and outbox are committed together when the action factory dependencies are present.
Transcription-only laboratory report draft create/update write the draft and audit row in one transaction; these separate draft records do not enqueue a controlled lab workflow event.
Document action dependency factory supplies PostgreSQL audit and outbox repositories; read-only factory is separate.
Quarantine action factory supplies transaction-capable audit/outbox repositories to receiving and inspection mutation repositories.
Template action factory supplies audit/outbox repositories; read-only dependencies are separately constructed.
Laboratory action factory supplies PostgreSQL audit/outbox repositories to mutation use cases.

evidenceBoundary: Repository source was inspected at the exact candidate SHA. The named integration/migration/concurrency suites did not provide PostgreSQL runtime proof because their PG cases were skipped or could not initialize. Passing non-PG cases do not establish PG18 rollback, immutability, concurrency, QMS effectivity, UAT, production readiness or earned points.
